work.author: Rabbinic sages (Babylonian redaction)
work.description: The Babylonian Talmud tractate on the reading of Esther and related scriptural-scroll law, redacted in late antiquity. Folios 8b-9b transmit the baraita of King Ptolemy's seventy-two elders and the changes they are said to have written for the king. Loci use standard Vilna folio-and-side numbering.
work.title: Babylonian Talmud, Tractate Megillah
